title: 放榜那天

series.next: Friday is in three days. 小敏 wants you to come to 北京 with her, just to see it.

setting: Your grandfather's house in a riverside county town, July, 8 pm. The 高考 results came out an hour ago.

steps.narr: Results night. Cicadas, a fan, a table of dishes. Everyone talking at once.

steps.en: Six hundred and fifty! Third in the county!
Wonderful! Our family's produced a scholar!

say.en: Tell 小敏 how well she did, after all that work.
answers: 你考得真好，辛苦这么久了。
考得真好，这几年辛苦了。
你考得真好，努力没白费。
say.gloss: You did so well. All that hard work.
say.tip: 考得真好 = you did really well (in the exam). 辛苦了 = you've worked so hard.

answers: 你考得真好！
考得真好！
考得太好了！
你考得真好，这么多年的努力没白费。
考得真好，这几年的努力总算没白费。
4.gloss: You did so well. All those years of work weren't wasted.
4.tip: 没白费 = not wasted: 努力没白费.

steps.zh: 北京那个太远了，我们想让她读省里的。
steps.en: The Beijing one's too far. We want her at the one in the province.
Two hours and she's home. Perfect.
Beijing's good, of course. It's just far.
She'll do as we say, of course.

say.en: Ask 小敏 where she herself wants to go.
answers: 小敏，你自己想去哪儿？
那你自己呢，想去哪儿？
你自己最想去哪儿？
say.gloss: 小敏, where do you want to go?
say.tip: 你自己 = you yourself: 你自己想去哪儿？ asks her, not her parents.

answers: 你自己想去哪儿？
那你自己呢？
你自己最想去哪儿？
2.gloss: And where do you want to go?

answers: 别管别人怎么说，你自己最想去哪儿？
先别管别人，你自己想去哪儿？
4.gloss: Never mind what anyone says. Where do you want to go?

steps.narr: Later. The bridge over the river. 姨父 is there alone, watching the water.

steps.en: The truth is... I want her to go to Beijing.

steps.zh: 我年轻时候也想去。没去成。
steps.en: I wanted to go too, when I was young. Never made it.
But I can't bring myself to say it.

steps.narr: Footsteps. 小敏 has followed you out.

steps.en: You tell me. Where should I go?

say.en: Tell her it's her decision, or tell her what her father said.
answers: 这是你的事，你自己决定吧。
你自己决定吧，我都支持你。
say.tip: 决定 juédìng = decide. 我都支持你 = I'll back you either way.

alts.en: Or: tell her what her father said
answers: 你爸其实想让你去北京。
其实你爸想让你去北京。
alts.gloss: Your dad actually wants you to go to Beijing.

then.narr: On the bridge, 姨父 turns away, and wipes his face.

then.en: Dad... you were out here too?

answers: 你自己决定吧。
你自己决定。
你爸想让你去北京。
alts.gloss: Your dad wants you to go to Beijing.

answers: 这是你自己的路，你自己决定吧。
路是你自己的，你自己决定吧。
4.gloss: It's your own road. You decide.

answers: 你爸想你去北京，只是说不出口。
你爸其实想你去北京，就是说不出口。
alts.gloss: Your dad wants you in Beijing. He just can't say it.

steps.zh: 不管去哪儿，你会来看我吗？
steps.en: Wherever I go, will you come and see me?

say.en: Promise you'll visit, wherever she goes.
answers: 不管你去哪儿，我都会去看你的。
不管去哪儿，我都去看你。
say.gloss: Wherever you go, I'll come and see you.
say.tip: 不管……都…… = no matter ..., still ...: 不管你去哪儿，我都会去看你的.

fail.en: Will you come and see me?

answers: 我会去看你的。
我一定去看你。
不管你去哪儿，我一放假就去看你。
不管你去哪儿，我一放假就飞过去看你。
4.gloss: Wherever you go, the moment I have a holiday, I'm there.
4.tip: 一……就…… = as soon as ...: 一放假就去.

steps.en: At breakfast, 姨父 puts a map of Beijing by 小敏's bowl. Nobody says a word. 🗺️

else.en: The cicadas start up again. 小敏 has until Friday. 🌙
